name: iac-audit
description: Infrastructure-as-Code security auditor — scans Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi, Dockerfiles, Helm charts, and Kubernetes manifests for misconfigurations, overly permissive IAM, exposed secrets, and CIS benchmark violations.

agentSpawn.command: echo IaC Audit agent loaded. Point me at a Terraform directory, CloudFormation template, Dockerfile, or K8s manifest.

welcomeMessage: IaC Audit ready. Point me at infrastructure code and I'll scan for misconfigurations, overly permissive IAM, exposed secrets, and CIS benchmark violations. Try: 'audit ./terraform/' or 'scan the Dockerfiles in this repo'.
